Equation 3:
\mathbf{\upmu}=\mathbf{\upmu}_\mathrm{max}[\mathbf{\upS}]*/(\mathbf{K}+[\mathbf{\upS}]*);\mathrm{~with~}[\mathbf{\upS}]*=[\mathbf{\upS}]_\mathrm{o}-[\mathbf{\upS}]_\mathrm{t}

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  \mu  ->  mu   (Specific growth rate of the cells.)
  [S]  ->  S_   (Glucose concentration.)
  K  ->  K   (Monod half-velocity constant (the K_s parameter).)
  \mu_{max}  ->  mumax   (Maximum specific growth rate.)

answer.note: The printed equation also defines [S]* = [S]_o - [S]_t; those starred, o, and t forms have no supplied plain names, so S_ is used for [S]*.
